source_snapshot.procedure: Verify configuration, clear logs, collect complete IB/OOB SDR lists, run the ambiguous literal `grep Ready and BIOS` against IB/OOB Sensor lists, and inspect BMC Web Sensor list.
source_snapshot.criteria: SDR, Sensor-list and Web name/description/reading match SPEC; numbering is 1, 2, 105.
source_snapshot.script: No Script; Config-Check; 3/0 minutes; unique code/variant.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES/ipmitool, but invents one sensor named `Check FW Ready` and truncates fallback SDR with `head -100`.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/HIGH; identifies the exact readiness-record, component/version, invalid-filter and criteria-numbering gaps.

old_problem: The shell text `grep Ready and BIOS` does not implement a Ready-and-BIOS conjunction: after the pattern, `and` and `BIOS` are file operands. Exact readiness records, their firmware-component/version dependencies and acceptable raw states are not supplied. DeepSeek invents an aggregate sensor and truncates evidence; criteria jump from 2 to 105.
disposition_reason: The review decision is resolvable without guessing OEM names: treat FW Ready as a Project-owned opaque set of discrete readiness records, bind every record to a firmware/BIOS component and active/staged version, and compare complete IB/OOB/Web evidence through a signed raw-state decoder. The invalid grep, synthetic aggregate target and truncation are rejected. Missing record IDs and decoder are runtime Project Configuration rather than an unresolved review decision.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2040, same-row DeepSeek, GPT V2, historical record, unique-code manifest result and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next row Functionality 2041 / Wistron-HW-00484-V002 / d6167928957fd81c was directly read from XLSX.
Firmware readiness can be represented by multiple OEM discrete records and is component/version/dependency specific; no universal aggregate sensor named from the item title is assumed.
The source grep is syntactically unsuitable for a logical conjunction, so full inventories followed by exact approved record selection preserve coverage and shell correctness.

ED-03 permits a parameterized OEM map but forbids guessed OEM semantics; ED-07 keeps firmware actions independently authorization-gated; ED-15 forbids a PASS without approved ready/not-ready/error rules; ED-17 preserves logs.
Criteria 1, 2 and 105 remain traceable; missing numbers are recorded and no absent criteria are invented.
No ipmitool, sensor read, authentication, Web capture, firmware query/change, reset, log clear or DUT action was performed.

test_case.purpose: Verify every approved firmware/BIOS readiness record maps to the correct component and active/staged firmware state, and that its raw/decoded readiness, description and freshness agree across supported IB/OOB SDR, Sensor List and BMC Web views without changing firmware.
required_package: Exact row-2040 Source Key/Variant plus SUT/BMC/BIOS/firmware inventory
Signed readiness-record IDs/types/inclusion list with component ownership and active/staged version/dependency map
Per-record raw-to-decoded ready/not-ready/error/unknown rules, aliases and freshness tolerance
Approved ipmitool plus protected IB/OOB/Web access and human Web/verdict responsibility
test_case.test_command: STRICTLY READ-ONLY PACKAGE-GATED; verify row-2040 variant identity and preserve pre-existing firmware/BMC/host/SEL evidence. Capture complete timestamped IB/OOB `sdr elist` and `sensor list` outputs without truncation. Select each owner-approved readiness record independently by exact ID/type; do not execute the literal `grep Ready and BIOS` or target a synthetic `Check FW Ready` sensor. Capture mapped Web Sensor rows and current firmware inventory, then compare component/version dependency, raw/decoded state and freshness through the signed matrix. Do not clear logs, flash, activate, downgrade, reset or retry automatically.
test_case.expected_result: Every approved readiness record is present exactly once for the correct component/version dependency and reports a fresh, SPEC-approved ready state consistently across all supported views; no component is missing, staged unexpectedly, initializing, failed, stale or represented only by a synthetic aggregate.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires the signed readiness population/component-version map/decoder plus complete aligned IB/OOB/Web and firmware-inventory evidence. FAIL on missing/extra/duplicate/stale record, wrong component/version/dependency, not-ready/error/unknown state or view disagreement. Missing mapping/decoder is NOT READY, not PASS; a human owns the Web review and verdict.
safety_gate: Passive inventory and sensor reads only; no firmware download, activation, rollback, BIOS write, reset or power cycle.
Preserve SEL/host/BMC evidence; no pre-test log clearing and no output truncation.
Stop on target/version ambiguity, not-ready/error/unknown state, stale record or view disagreement.
Protect credentials and do not automatically retry or remediate a readiness failure.
expected_evidence: Exact Source Key/Variant/hash and invalid-filter/criteria-numbering defect record
Signed readiness-record population, component/version/dependency map and raw-state decoder
Complete timestamped IB/OOB SDR and Sensor-list outputs with exits/hashes
Current firmware inventory and every mapped BMC Web Sensor row
Per-record component/version/raw/decoded/freshness comparison with missing/extra/duplicate analysis
test_case.recovery: On wrong identity/version, access failure, not-ready/error/unknown state or view mismatch, stop passive collection and preserve first raw output plus firmware/SEL context. Close sessions and rotate exposed credentials. Do not flash, activate, reset, clear logs or retry; escalate the exact component and record.

source_conflict.reason: Full inventory plus a signed exact-record matrix replaces the invalid Ready/BIOS grep and synthetic aggregate while retaining every source surface and criterion.

blocked.reason: The read-only purpose, evidence, verdict logic, safety and recovery are complete; OEM record IDs and decoding are permitted Project Configuration.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Exact readiness records/types, component/version/dependency bindings, raw-state decoder, aliases, freshness tolerance and protected endpoints.
pending.execution_status: REVIEW RESOLVED TO PARAMETERIZED READ-ONLY FW-READINESS MATRIX; NO IPMITOOL, SENSOR READ, AUTHENTICATION, WEB CAPTURE, FIRMWARE QUERY/CHANGE, RESET, LOG CLEAR OR DUT ACTION EXECUTED
